sources.title: White House takes phones from reporters traveling from China with president
Reporters’ phones taken on Air Force One in rare security move

en.title: Reporters' phones taken aboard Air Force One after China trip
en.dek: Reporters' phones were confiscated during Trump's departure from China on Thursday
facts: Reporters traveling with President Trump had their phones taken away as they departed China on Thursday.
An AFP journalist on board reported at 6:45pm: 'Our phones are being taken away for now for security reasons.'
Fox News correspondent Jacqui Heinrich, president of the White House Correspondents' Association, said phones had not been collected following Trump's previous China visit in May.
The move, together with changes to flight restrictions over Alaska, raised questions about whether Air Force One was heading directly home.
body: Reporters traveling with President Trump had their phones taken away as they departed China on Thursday. An AFP journalist on board the plane reported shortly after it left Shenzhen that their phones were being taken away for now for security reasons.

Fox News correspondent Jacqui Heinrich, president of the White House Correspondents' Association, stated that journalists' phones had not been collected following Trump's previous visit to China in May, suggesting this move was unusual.

The phone confiscation, together with changes to flight restrictions over Alaska, raised questions about whether Air Force One was heading directly home. No further explanation for the unusual precaution was immediately provided.
en.context: President Trump was returning to the United States after traveling to China, where he had raised the possibility of meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, although no such encounter had been announced.
en.imageCaption: The move, together with changes to flight restrictions over Alaska, raised questions about whether Air Force One was heading directly home.

fr.title: Téléphones des journalistes saisis à bord d'Air Force One après le voyage en Chine
fr.dek: Les téléphones des journalistes ont été confisqués lors du départ de Trump de Chine jeudi
facts: Les journalistes accompagnant le président Trump ont vu leurs téléphones confisqués en quittant la Chine jeudi
Un journaliste de l'AFP à bord a rapporté à 18h45 : « Nos téléphones sont mis de côté pour le moment pour des raisons de sécurité. »

Jacqui Heinrich, correspondante de Fox News et présidente de l'Association des correspondants de la Maison Blanche, a indiqué que les téléphones n'avaient pas été collectés lors de la précédente visite de Trump en Chine en mai
Cette mesure, associée à des changements dans les restrictions de vol au-dessus de l'Alaska, a soulevé des questions sur le fait qu'Air Force One se dirigeait directement vers le pays
body: Reporters accompanying President Trump had their phones seized as they departed China on Thursday. An AFP journalist on board the aircraft reported shortly after it left Shenzhen that their phones were being taken away for security reasons.

Fox News correspondent Jacqui Heinrich, president of the White House Correspondents' Association, stated that journalists' phones had not been collected following Trump's previous visit to China in May, suggesting this move was unusual.

The phone confiscation, together with changes to flight restrictions over Alaska, raised questions about whether Air Force One was heading directly home. No further explanation for the unusual precaution was immediately provided.
fr.context: Le président Trump rentrait aux États-Unis après un voyage en Chine, où il avait évoqué la possibilité de rencontrer le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong Un, bien qu'aucune rencontre n'ait été annoncée.
fr.imageCaption: Cette mesure, associée à des changements dans les restrictions de vol au-dessus de l'Alaska, a soulevé des questions sur le fait qu'Air Force One se dirigeait directement vers le pays

pt.title: Telefones de repórteres apreendidos a bordo do Air Force One após viagem a China
pt.dek: Telefones de repórteres foram apreendidos durante a partida de Trump da China na quinta-feira
facts: Repórteres que viajavam com o presidente Trump tiveram os telefones apreendidos ao partir da China na quinta-feira.
Um jornalista da AFP a bordo relatou às 18h45: 'Os nossos telefones estão a ser apreendidos por agora por razões de segurança.'

A correspondente da Fox News, Jacqui Heinrich, presidente da Associação de Correspondentes da Casa Branca, disse que os telefones não foram recolhidos após a visita anterior de Trump a China, em maio.
A medida, juntamente com alterações nas restrições de voo sobre o Alasca, levantou questões sobre se o Air Force One estava a rumar diretamente para casa.
body: Repórteres que viajavam com o Presidente Trump tiveram os telefones apreendidos ao partir da China na quinta-feira. Um jornalista da AFP a bordo do avião reportou pouco depois de o mesmo partir de Shenzhen que os seus telefones estavam a ser apreendidos por motivos de segurança, por agora.

Jacqui Heinrich, correspondente da Fox News e presidente da Associação dos Correspondentes da Casa Branca, afirmou que os telefones dos jornalistas não tinham sido recolhidos após a visita anterior de Trump à China, em maio, sugerindo que esta medida era incomum.

A apreensão dos telefones, juntamente com alterações nas restrições de voo sobre o Alasca, levantou questões sobre se o Air Force One estava a rumar diretamente para casa. Não foi imediatamente fornecida qualquer explicação adicional para esta precaução incomum.
pt.context: O presidente Trump regressava aos Estados Unidos após viajar a China, onde tinha levantado a possibilidade de encontrar o líder norte-coreano Kim Jong Un, embora nenhum encontro tivesse sido anunciado.
pt.imageCaption: A medida, juntamente com alterações nas restrições de voo sobre o Alasca, levantou questões sobre se o Air Force One estava a rumar diretamente para home.

zh.title: 记者在空军一号上手机被没收 结束中国之行
zh.dek: 特朗普周四离开中国时，记者手机被扣押
facts: 随特朗普总统前往中国的记者在周四离开中国时手机被没收
一名在机上的法新社记者于下午6:45报道：“出于安全原因，我们的手机暂时被收走了。”
福克斯新闻记者雅奎·海因里希是白宫记者协会主席，她表示在特朗普五月前访华时并未收缴手机
此举连同阿拉斯加空域限制的变更，引发了空军一号是否直飞回国的疑问
body: 随特朗普总统一同前往的记者在周四离开中国时被没收了手机。一名在飞机上的法新社记者在飞机离开深圳后不久报告称，出于安全原因，他们的手机暂时被收走了。
福克斯新闻记者雅奎·海因里希（Jacqui Heinrich）表示，在特朗普五月访问中国时，记者的手机并未被收缴，这表明此次举动不寻常。
手机被没收，以及阿拉斯加空域飞行限制的变更，引发了关于“空军一号”是否直飞回国的疑问。对于这一不寻常的预防措施，没有立即提供进一步的解释。
zh.context: 特朗普总统在中国访问后返回美国，此前他曾提出可能与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面，但尚未宣布此类会面
zh.imageCaption: 此举连同阿拉斯加空域限制的变更，引发了空军一号是否直飞回国的疑问

ko.title: 트럼프 중국 방문 후 에어 포스 원에서 기자 휴대폰 압수
ko.dek: 트럼프 전 대통령의 중국 출발 시 기자들의 휴대폰 압수됨
facts: 트럼프 대통령과 동행한 기자들은 목요일 중국을 떠나면서 휴대폰을 압수당했다
AFP 기자가 탑승 중 오후 6시 45분에 보도하기를 "보안상의 이유로 현재 휴대폰이 압수되고 있습니다"
포ks 뉴스 특파원 재키 하인리히는 백악관 기자 협회 회장으로서 트럼프의 지난 5월 중국 방문 시에는 휴대폰이 회수되지 않았다고 말했다
이번 조치와 알래스카 상공 비행 제한 변경은 에어 포스 원이 바로 귀국하는 것인지에 대한 의문을 제기했다
body: 트럼프 대통령과 동행한 기자들의 휴대폰이 목요일 중국을 떠나면서 압수되었다. 비행기 이륙 직후 선전에서 AFP 기자는 보안상의 이유로 휴대폰이 일단 압수되었다고 보도했다.
포ks 뉴스 특파원인 재키 하인리히는 백악관 기자 협회 회장으로서 트럼프 대통령의 지난 5월 중국 방문 시 기자들의 휴대폰이 수거되지 않았다고 밝히며 이번 조치가 이례적임을 시사했다.
휴대폰 압수와 알래스카 상공 비행 제한 변경은 에어 포스 원이 바로 귀국하는 것인지에 대한 의문을 제기했으며, 이 이례적인 예방 조치에 대한 추가 설명은 즉시 제공되지 않았다.
ko.context: 트럼프 대통령은 북한 김정은 위원장과의 만남 가능성을 언급했으나 실제 만남은 발표되지 않은 가운데 중국 방문 후 미국으로 귀국하고 있었다
ko.imageCaption: 이번 조치와 알래스카 상공 비행 제한 변경은 에어 포스 원이 바로 귀국하는 것인지에 대한 의문을 제기했다

de.title: Telefone von Reportern an Bord von Air Force One nach China-Besuch beschlagnahmt
de.dek: Telefone von Reportern wurden bei Trumps Abreise aus China am Donnerstag beschlagnahmt
facts: Reporter, die mit Präsident Trump reisten, hatten ihre Telefone bei der Abreise aus China am Donnerstag abgenommen
Ein AFP-Journalist an Bord berichtete um 18:45 Uhr: „Unsere Telefone werden aus Sicherheitsgründen vorerst entzogen.“
Die Fox News Korrespondentin Jacqui Heinrich, Präsidentin der White House Correspondents' Association, gab an, dass nach Trumps frühem China-Besuch im Mai keine Telefone eingezogen worden waren
Diese Maßnahme zusammen mit Änderungen der Flugbeschränkungen über Alaska warf Fragen auf, ob Air Force One direkt nach Hause flog
body: Reporter, die mit Präsident Trump unterwegs waren, hatten ihre Telefone beschlagnahmt bekommen, als sie am Donnerstag China verließen. Ein AFP-Journalist an Bord der Maschine berichtete kurz nach dem Abflug aus Shenzhen, dass deren Telefone vorübergehend wegen Sicherheitsgründen beschlagnahmt würden.

Fox-News-Korrespondentin Jacqui Heinrich, Präsidentin des Weißen Haus-Presserings, erklärte, dass Journalisten-Folgen nach Trumps vorherigem China-Besuch im Mai nicht eingezogen worden seien, und deutete damit an, dass diese Maßnahme ungewöhnlich sei.

Die Telefon-Beschlagnahme zusammen mit Änderungen der Flugbeschränkungen über Alaska warf Fragen auf, ob die Air Force One direkt nach Hause fliege. Für die ungewöhnliche Vorsichtsmaßnahme wurde zunächst keine weitere Erklärung geliefert.
de.context: Präsident Trump kehrte aus China in die Vereinigten Staaten zurück, wo er die Möglichkeit eines Treffens mit dem nordkoreanischen Führer Kim Jong Un angesprochen hatte, obwohl ein solches Treffen nicht angekündigt wurde.
de.imageCaption: Diese Maßnahme zusammen mit Änderungen der Flugbeschränkungen über Alaska warf Fragen auf, ob Air Force One direkt nach Hause flog

es.title: Los teléfonos de los periodistas fueron confiscados a bordo de Air Force One tras el viaje a China
es.dek: Los teléfonos de los periodistas fueron retenidos durante la salida de Trump de China el jueves
facts: Reporters traveling with President Trump had their phones taken away as they departed China on Thursday
An AFP journalist on board reported at 6:45pm: 'Nuestros teléfonos se están llevando por ahora por razones de seguridad.'
Fox News correspondent Jacqui Heinrich, president of the White House Correspondents' Association, said phones had not been collected following Trump's previous China visit in May
The move, together with changes to flight restrictions over Alaska, raised questions about whether Air Force One was heading directly home.
body: Los teléfonos de los periodistas fueron confiscados a bordo de Air Force One tras el viaje a China. Los periodistas que viajaban con el presidente Trump tuvieron sus teléfonos confiscados al partir de China el jueves. Un periodista de AFP a bordo del avión informó poco después de que este partió de Shenzhen de que sus teléfonos estaban siendo retirados temporalmente por razones de seguridad.

Fox News corresponsal Jacqui Heinrich, presidenta de la Asociación de Corresponsales de la Casa Blanca, señaló que los teléfonos de los periodistas no habían sido retenidos tras la visita anterior de Trump a China en mayo, lo que sugiere que este movimiento era inusual.

El secuestro de los teléfonos, junto con los cambios en las restricciones de vuelo sobre Alaska, planteó dudas sobre si Air Force One se dirigía directamente a casa. No se ofreció ninguna explicación inmediata sobre esta precaución inusual.
es.context: Presidente Trump regresaba a Estados Unidos después de viajar a China, donde había planteado la posibilidad de reunirse con el líder norcoreano Kim Jong Un, aunque no se había anunciado ningún encuentro.
es.imageCaption: El movimiento, junto con cambios a las restricciones de vuelo sobre Alaska, planteó dudas sobre si Air Force One regresaba directamente a casa.

problemsFixed: Headline exceeds 90 characters. Body contains speculative framing ('rare security measure', 'unusual precaution') without attribution. Sentences 1 and 2 in body are repetitive. Paragraph structure violates rule 13 (same noun opening consecutive paragraphs). No source explains why phones were taken or whether Air Force One was heading directly home — these are presented as fact but are unsupported. 'Jacqui Heinrich' is not attributed as 'president of the White House Correspondents' Association' in the body text. Context paragraph invents a 'summit of world leaders' detail not in sources.
